steps.reasoning: Search for the workout plan using an instruction-derived term and exhaust pagination; if that query has no matches, exhaustively read note metadata so the plan can still be selected from real data.
steps.action_code:
def read_all_note_pages(query_value):
    collected = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query=query_value, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        collected.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return collected
note_search_query = 'workout'
workout_note_summaries = read_all_note_pages(note_search_query)
if not workout_note_summaries:
    note_search_query = ''
    workout_note_summaries = read_all_note_pages(note_search_query)
print(workout_note_summaries)
verification_targets: Every page for the effective note search is read
Candidate note IDs and metadata are available
